market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with upside capped by RBA inflation concerns and recession fears. Banks and gas names lead; miners lag. Qantas strike and fuel supply crunch add volatility. Anthropic datacentre news provides a tech/infra tailwind.
market_outlook.long_term: 2027 recession risk and IMF fiscal warnings suggest a cautious 6–12 month horizon. Energy transition policy (Victoria backing away from renewables, coal course) creates structural uncertainty. Anthropic-scale datacentre deals and WA critical-minerals exploration offer medium-term growth pockets. Housing affordability remains a systemic drag on consumer spending.
